name: Eo Gio
kicker: The rock saddle above the sea
summary: Stand in the gap between two rock ridges and look down at the sea. The fee is 25,000 đồng, and children under 0.9 m are free. One page calls the sunset the finest in Vietnam. A 2021 page on the same portal calls it the finest sunrise.
getThere: On Phuong Mai, east of the lagoon. Minutes from the beach are check on arrival.
bestMonths: Lunar month 3 through the end of lunar month 9, if the sea is calm
heroCaption: The saddle at Eo Gió, with both rock walls and the sea
gettingThere: The header says khu số 4, Nhơn Lý–Cát Tiến, Phường Quy Nhơn Đông. The prose says khu vực 3, thôn Lý Lương, xã đảo Nhơn Lý. The site is on Phương Mai, east of the lagoon. Kilometres and minutes from the city beach are check on arrival.
A 2021 news page says a resort sits 2 km by road and 10 minutes by water from here. That resort is not a pick.

legs.heading: From the city beach
legs.body: Across Thị Nại, then on to Phương Mai. The portal does not print the kilometres or the minutes from the sand. Check on arrival.

closed: No weekly closing day is printed. Stay away when the sea is rough. The page’s calm window is lunar month 3 through the end of lunar month 9.
admissionNote: 25,000 đồng. Children under 0.9 m free. Do not treat Kỳ Co’s 30,000–60,000 đồng header as this ticket.

links.label: 24 Feb 2021 sunrise note
links.note: Same portal. Calls it the finest sunrise.
